summary: A force's arrival resolves into control of the cell it reached -- unheld or undefended ground changes hands through set_control, a defended cell does not and says so -- and the player raises and dispatches Michael's forces through two bridge verbs.

coordination.notes: tick.rs takes three appended StrategicEvent variants at the END of the enum and no new PURPOSES entry -- the hash contract's draw sequence is untouched. expedition.rs takes one statement in strategic_tick between advance_forces and eliminate_exhausted_factions (the card names tick.rs; the call to advance_forces lives in expedition.rs, so the one call goes where its neighbour is). godot_bridge.rs takes two #[func]s at the END of the impl and one arm per new variant in journal_entry_dictionary and journal_prose. information_surface.gd takes kind-list entries only. board_verification_campaign.gd's save round trip is replaced by the verbs as its own note demands; isometric_board_test.gd (P10's file otherwise) is repaired only where it reads that helper's result.
